'''Ross Littauer''' is an inactive member of [[Team 5]]<ref name="slack-2021">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Joe Olson (arebelspy), 14 January 2021</ref>. He played the [[2018 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-world-championships/ 2018 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
